"""Camera guided Panda controller for placing the answer 40. No simulator access."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import json
OUT=Path('/app/output')
def observe():
    r=Robot()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
    res.save(OUT/'initial')
    print(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    print(res.meta)
if __name__=='__main__':
    observe()
